subject: Request: DeltaWave long-term uplift carveout & price protection — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Amir Qureshi <amir@deltawave.com>
Cc: DeltaWave Legal <legal@deltawave.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: DeltaWave long-term uplift carveout & price protection — exec approval needed

Hi team — forwarding the latest from DeltaWave and asking for quick exec alignment. Key asks from customer (DeltaWave, Amir on copy):

- 3-year price lock on the base unit price (no increase >0% for the first 36 months).
- Annual uplift cap at 3% (they want language so increases cannot exceed 3% per year).
- Renewal protection clause: if they expand usage within 90 days of renewal, they want the renewal to be calculated using an annualized blended rate that cannot exceed a 5% increase vs prior year (they call this a ‘renewal parity safeguard’).
- 20% first-year discount off list for committed capacity (they want this carved into the SOW).

Deal economics (summary):
- Expected TCV: $3.2M over 36 months
- First-year ARR: $1.05M
- Expected average monthly QPS footprint: medium (fits on Dedicated pool A)

Why we’re considering: strategic sector fit and likely multi-product expansion in H2. Risk: long price lock with uplift cap could tie our pricing vs model/hardware inflation.

Attachments: DeltaWave_Redwood_TS_v3.docx (redline), HSP_analysis.xlsx (unit economics).

Ask: Marissa/Ben/Kimberly — do we have exec clearance to accept the 3-yr lock + 3% uplift cap + renewal protection language as drafted? If not, what guardrails do you want to impose (minimum commit, escrow, step-up floors)?

I can push back on 20% -> 18% or request an annual minimum consumption clause; want to move fast — Amir expects our answer by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Rishi — thanks for the summary and attachments. A few quick points from Deal Desk perspective: 

1) Renewal protection needs a clearer trigger and measurement. "Renewal parity safeguard" is vague; Legal should confirm whether we accept a blended annualized calculation or insist on usage tiers tied to committed minimums.

2) If we do a 3% uplift cap, we should limit the first renewal year to 2% (or include a floor that prevents cumulative downward pricing pressure). Otherwise we expose adjacent customers to price pressure if spot costs drop.

3) 20% is high vs precedent for this segment. I would be comfortable with 18% if we get a 12-month minimum committed spend and an ML usage floor (e.g., minimum token consumption or reserved capacity).

Please loop in Legal to redline the renewal protection language — I want to see: trigger window, calculation method, and carveouts (force majeure, significant model license cost increases).

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks for the context. Quick finance perspective:

- We can support a multi-year commitment with a price-lock if the customer signs a non-cancellable minimum commitment equal to at least 70% of projected first-year consumption and settles the first two quarters up front (or provides an escrow arrangement).
- Discount: willing to flex to 18% if the minimum commit is present. No more than 18% without additional guarantees.
- Uplift cap: propose 2.5% rather than 3% — smaller concession helps preserve margin against model/hardware cost increases.
- Renewal protection: we need to exclude material model-license cost increases (e.g., third-party model price spikes) and include a clause that allows us to re-open pricing on material cost changes.

I've attached a short finance memo outlining sensitivity (finance_signoff_request.pdf).

If Deal Desk wants to present the 18% / 2.5% uplift / 70% minimum commit + escrow path to the customer, finance can greenlight. Otherwise we should decline the 20%/3%/full-lock ask.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Team — after reviewing the deal and finance/legal inputs, I am authorizing the following counter-proposal as final and approved for signature by DeltaWave: 

- 3-year price lock on base unit rate, subject to the exceptions below.
- Annual uplift cap set at 2.5% per year.
- Renewal protection: blended annualized renewal calculation permitted but with the following guardrails: only applies when the customer maintains the committed minimum for at least 270 of the prior 365 days; excludes third-party model license cost increases and force majeure; Redwood reserves right to re-open pricing if total model + infra unit costs increase by >8%.
- First-year discount set to 18% (not 20%) contingent on a 70% non-cancellable first-year minimum and either prepayment of first two quarters or a $300k escrow.

Deal Desk: please update HubSpot (deal DW-4921) with the approved terms and send the final SOW for DocuSign using the link below. Legal: please push the redline to DeltaWave Legal and confirm acceptance.
